about: guideflow2: the why and do of every Battle Guide failure; written from WORDS in tools/guidegen/store.py (python3 tools/guidegen/store.py words). Never edit by hand.

X5.do: Add credit at fal, then tap Try again.

X6.why: The video service returned no video. Nothing was spent.

X7.do: It stays queued and starts when a place frees up.

X8.why: The job stopped before it finished.
X8.do_paid: The video was paid for and is kept; Try again costs nothing.

X9.do: Change the prompt, then tap Make another.

X10.do: It is shown as Ready with the check's words in red above it. You decide.

X12.why: It faced right, so it was flipped. Lettering and anything worn on one side are now reversed.
X12.do: Make another or Upload my own.

X13.why: The background is not one flat magenta.
X13.do: Paint the background plain magenta, or send a picture with a see-through background, then tap Upload my own.

X14.why: The figure touches the edge of the picture.
X14.do: Leave a little empty space on every side, then tap Upload my own.

X16.why: It was made but could not be saved.
X16.do: Tap Try again; it costs nothing.

X17.why: GitHub was too busy to save it.
